metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.7 · 1982 · First Blood

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.5 · 1985 · Rambo: First Blood Part II

metas.description: Rambo must confront his past and unearth his ruthless combat skills to exact revenge in a final mission.
